719-3510-3875-8168.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Xenograft.
719-3510-3875-8168.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each permanent that entered is a Saproling through Xenograft and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Provisioner to trigger.
Resolve a Tireless Provisioner trigger, replacing the artifact token creation with that many 5/5 Dragons through Draconic Visitor.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

3490-4068-7075-7763.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
You control at least one Mountain.
3490-4068-7075-7763.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1981-2034-2415-7286.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

225-1479-5700-5701-7885.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
225-1479-5700-5701-7885.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Down in the Valley trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Down in the Valley and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Down in the Valley triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

3490-4659-6720-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4659-6720-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1806-2034-2060-4772-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Doubling Season.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

2457-4289-6753-7175.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

3814-5517-6871.description:
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping it as it's a land due to Toph and another land you control.
Repeat.

3101-3292-3892-6965.easyPrerequisites: You have an amount of {R} available equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin.
3101-3292-3892-6965.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
3101-3292-3892-6965.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

4050-5353-6887.notablePrerequisites: The total toughness of other creatures you control is at least 10 plus The Pride of Hull Clade's commander tax.
4050-5353-6887.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The Pride of Hull Clade, adding {G}.
Choose to return The Pride of Hull Clade from your graveyard to the command zone.
When The Pride of Hull Clade dies, The Skullspore Nexus triggers, creating a 2/2 Fungus Dinosaur creature token.
Cast The Pride of Hull Clade from the command zone by paying {G}, as its cost will be reduced by the toughness of creatures you control.
Repeat.

2438-2510-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2438-2510-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2438-2510-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

147-413-6475.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Reunion of the House.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-3363-5078-5901.notablePrerequisites: Artist's Talent is at least level 2.
1170-3363-5078-5901.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

3525-6037.easyPrerequisites: Pemmin's Aura attached to Twitching Doll.
3525-6037.notablePrerequisites: Twitching Doll does not have summoning sickness.
3525-6037.description:
Activate Twitching Doll's first ability by tapping it, adding {U} and putting a nest counter on it.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Twitching Doll
Repeat any number of times.
Activate Twitching Doll's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing it, creating a 2/2 green Spider creature token with reach for each counter on Twitching Doll.

433-1656-4543.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
433-1656-4543.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Llanowar Scout's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Necrotic Ooze.
Repeat.

2103-2660-2707.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Capture of Jingzhou is put on the bottom of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Move to your extra turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou from the bottom of your library during your draw step due to River Song.
Repeat.

2493-3542-3647.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
2493-3542-3647.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Palinchron.
When Palinchron and Archaeomancer enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Displace to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

751-803-2972.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it and Ganax trigger.
Resolve the Shireking Drake trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

1335-1988-4050.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Elemental, adding {1}.
When the Elemental dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marath.
Repeat.

3263-4003-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel does not have summoning sickness.
Mu Yanling has at least ten loyalty counters on it.
3263-4003-4312.description:
Activate Vorel by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of loyalty counters on Mu Yanling.
Activate Mu Yanling's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2034-2450-2654-5195.description:
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Shark Typhoon and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Shark Typhoon trigger, creating a 1/1 Shark creature token.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Shark, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2414-2689-3368-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with power seven or greater.
2414-2689-3368-4050.description:
Cast Thud by paying {R} and sacrificing a creature you control with power seven or greater.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Thud and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the Thud copy, causing you to create at least seven 3/1 Elemental Shaman creature tokens with haste due to Hostility.
Activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven Elemental Shamans, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hostility, adding {R}.
Hostility dies, shuffling itself into your library from your graveyard.
Cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Thud and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the Thud copy, dealing at least seven damage to any target.
Repeat from step 8.

364-1987-2556-3573.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
364-1987-2556-3573.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
